summary: Datepicker package downloads Bun runtime at preinstall to execute obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue datepicker, but package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers such as _0xXXXX) and, at npm install time, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (pinned to bun-v1.3.13), extracts the platform-specific bun binary, chmods it 0755, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line file with a '// @bun @bun-cjs' header, a large shuffled constant array (n7gIxM), and a rotating-array string decoder (WV8StW) — a Bun-bundled obfuscated blob. math_init.js is not listed in package.json 'files' (only 'lib/*' is declared), so the payload is shipped in the tarball outside the declared file manifest. There is no datepicker functionality served by fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime and using it to execute an obfuscated sibling script at install time; this is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern, granting arbitrary code execution on the installer's host on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
